title: Great connecting.
premise: Synergy personalizes every conference follow-up. One reply needs a keyboard player, not another meaningful connection.
tension: Synergy wants to demonstrate that the conference created valuable relationships; Kevin needs a specific introduction; People & Culture asks what the other person actually said.
beats: Open on the practical request: Miriam needs a keyboard player for Friday. Kevin asks whether anyone followed up.
Synergy has used ChatGPT to draft personalized messages. Each sounds sincere but does not answer Miriam’s question.
People asks what they discussed. Kevin remembers the session and recognizes that Keys could help.
They ask Keys about availability and consent to the introduction. Synergy turns the elaborate draft into a short, specific reply.
The printer finishes the follow-up plan. Synergy pauses over a LinkedIn reflection, then returns to Miriam’s actual conversation.
resolution: One useful introduction. Synergy makes a real connection by listening.

opening_dialogue.text: What did you and Miriam talk about?
She needs a keyboard player for Friday.
